scope: Sequential local Debug observations on a shared machine. Builds and other worktree activity can overlap samples. No causal timing, empty-cache, cloud transport or archive-scale throughput qualification.
cache_contract: Process restart retains OS and persistent caches and readiness warming; no empty-cache claim.
changes: Preserve eligible native physical ordering before global metadata demand and share native single-term cost selection.
Keep row references and at most one full final boundary key per ordered page; omit unused covers.
Probe supported sparse Boolean/term membership in batches of at most 64 candidates, retaining dense/pattern bitmap fallback.
Bind private exact-membership evidence to snapshot, prepared text program and finite include slice; retain original scoring and residual checks.
Prefetch at most four selected serving packs through shared I/O scheduler lanes; join/cancel tasks before releasing publication state.
Retain one outer-wave stored source pin only when every winner belongs to it; validate before restoring native ordinals and preserve physical hydration otherwise.

deterministic_qualification.pre_fix_real_parquet_regressions: Both performance assertions failed on the reviewed binary: 1024 speculative visits on selective native ordering, and wide-key budget fallback.
deterministic_qualification.sparse_probe_test: 128 native rows; Boolean page results equal the full bitmap; zero full bitmap builds; retained probes reused.
deterministic_qualification.wide_reader_test: 20 references with 96 KiB nonconstant suffixes and one final boundary fit a 512 KiB page allocation budget.
deterministic_qualification.pack_wave_test: Parallel overlap, inline saturation, optional open failure and cancellation; created/released pins balance and scheduler reservations return to zero.
deterministic_qualification.witness_test: Snapshot, program and finite selection identity mismatches cannot authorize skipped text eligibility.
deterministic_qualification.delivery_test: No prefetched outer pin or no requested stored coverage declines retention; mixed packs decline ordinal restoration without partial mutation.

intermediate_wide_delivery_observation.interpretation: One sample per cache mode. Boundary memory was fixed, but end-to-end warm latency rose to 2.73 s from the reviewed 2.18 s single sample. This prompted retaining the proven winning source for final projection; final paired repeated results follow below.
